> (auto generated by Claude)

## Motivation

`SparsePrefillChunkCache.ensure_compressed` built the per-request compressed lengths with `torch.tensor(lengths_cpu, dtype=torch.int32, device=device)`. Creating a CUDA tensor from a Python list copies from pageable host memory, so each prefill step paid a pageable H2D copy followed by a stream synchronize when the compressed gather was constructed. This drains the GPU queue and defeats the `output_size` already passed to `repeat_interleave` to avoid a sync.

## Modifications

Build `lengths` with `async_h2d`, which stages the list in pinned memory and enqueues a non-blocking copy on the current stream, as the other DSv4 code paths already do. Values, dtype and device are unchanged.

detail.title: [DSv4] Sparse prefill: build compressed lengths without a host sync

files.patch:
@@ -41,6 +41,7 @@
 
 from sglang.kernels.ops.attention.dsv4.dequant_k_cache import DIM_NOPE, DIM_ROPE
 from sglang.srt.utils import ceil_align
+from sglang.srt.utils.common import async_h2d
 
 # FlashMLA sparse prefill asserts ``params.topk % B_TOPK == 0``. B_TOPK is 64
 # for the h_q=64 kernel and 128 for h_q=128; pad to 128 to satisfy both.
@@ -563,7 +564,7 @@ def ensure_compressed(
             seq_lens_cpu = self.seq_lens.tolist()
         lengths_cpu = [int(length) // compress_ratio for length in seq_lens_cpu]
         total_compressed = sum(lengths_cpu)
-        lengths = torch.tensor(lengths_cpu, dtype=torch.int32, device=device)
+        lengths = async_h2d(lengths_cpu, dtype=torch.int32, device=device)
         ends = lengths.cumsum(0, dtype=torch.int32)
         compressed_base = ends - lengths
         swa_base = total_compressed + self.swa_offsets[:-1]
